question: The same questions answered by Jev
why: The core technique (transcript 4:17 to 6:44). It decides the vendor question and the cost.
hypothesis: Highest accuracy on closed sets, lower on Hebrew prompts.
cost_estimate: about 330 Jev requests (the test tree's estimate): about 105 typed requests per run on the 20-persona sample (315 over three runs), plus about 76 per run on syn1 (228); measured on extract/haiku-typed's runs, which asked the same questions. The model batch step adds a few Haiku calls per persona.

deviations.from: test tree row: syn2 only (synthetic text)
deviations.what: Amendment A1 replaces syn2 with anon-personas (kind real, anonymized); Amendment A2, decision 3 (Yotam, 2026-11-11), allows Jev on the anonymized sample only, so the row's 'syn2 only (synthetic text)' becomes the seeded 20-persona sample of anon-personas. As a model case it runs the A2 seeded sample, the same one as reverify/heldout-personas and extract/haiku-typed: sample_dataset anon-personas, sample_size 20, sample_seed 20261110, random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(user_ids), 20). syn1 (synthetic) stays as the reference, reported beside, never alone. The runner still refuses to build a Jev client for a real dataset that is not anonymized; that guard is unchanged.
deviations.cost: Running all 188 personas of anon-personas would cost about 9x the planned budget.
deviations.labels: Labels on anon-personas were written by headless Claude and are not human-reviewed (A2, decision 1): every verdict carries the caveat 'labels not human-reviewed'.
deviations.bars: The accuracy bars are copied from extract/haiku-typed (the row says 'same accuracy bars'): slot_accuracy mean >= 0.85 and min >= 0.80, over_inferred <= 0.05, first_session_fill >= 0.75, all on anon-personas. The row names no aggregation for the last two, so each uses the default, mean. haiku-typed's run_agreement bar is a real1 clause of that row; this row has none, so run_agreement is not a bar here.
deviations.language: 'Reported separately for Hebrew and English prompts' is the metrics slot_accuracy_by_lang@he, slot_accuracy_by_lang@en, over_inferred_by_lang@he and over_inferred_by_lang@en (aspect metrics, extract/metrics.py), with no bar: the figures on the overall bars stay the only gates. A persona is Hebrew when more than half of its prompts hold more Hebrew-block letters than Latin letters; every other persona (a tie, or no prompt) is English.
deviations.typed: Strategy hybrid_jev: one Jev request per turn over the last 12 prompts through JevTypedClient (jev-1.13.0), plus one small request per standing instruction. The replay pipeline already simulates the learner's tap on each proposal for this strategy and counts Jev's requests as typed_questions, so pipeline.py adds nothing to it. The live run needs PERSONALIZATION_ALLOW_JEV=true and TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the shell; without either the case is recorded invalid.
